celfmt -agent -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
run_as_cel: true
cel:
  state:
    a: 1
{{#if max_executions}}
  max_executions: {{max_executions}}
{{else}}
  program: |
    state.with({"events":[],"want_more":false})
{{/if}}
-- want.txt --
run_as_cel: true
cel:
  state:
    a: 1
{{#if max_executions}}
  max_executions: {{max_executions}}
{{else}}
  program: |-
    state.with({"events": [], "want_more": false})
{{/if}}
